description: A configurable 2D game character sprite: Faceless industrial quadruped crusher guardian. No head, no eyes, no humanoid arms, no brass round belly. Broad angular dark slate armored press housing, red furnace cracks inside clamp mouth at LEFT, four thick articulated steel legs with wide feet. Menacing low insect stance. All limbs attached. Original CLOCKWORK enemy clearly unlike cute round hero Tique.

animations.name: idle
animations.action: subtle hydraulic settle 1-2 pixel body height, feet planted, tiny furnace pulse, identical silhouette

animations.name: attack
animations.action: compress leg pistons and pull clamp back, coil anticipation, low forward lunge with clamp open, clamp slams shut, heavy recoil, settle; whole poses, four thick attached legs, same body size and foot baseline

animations.name: stagger
animations.action: armor shutters slightly open showing red furnace between angular plates, whole body recoils with legs braced then settles; same proportions and feet baseline
